name: Watermelon Kush Choice Chews | 200mg
description:
Chill out with Choice Chew's indica enhanced Sour Watermelon Kush gummies. We combined a juicy burst of watermelon, a punch of sour, and the soft touch of indica to create the perfect marriage of flavor and feels. 

Made from scratch and infused with premium high-potency distillate, it's no wonder that Choice Chews are a Michigan favorite!
